description: As a mobile build engineer, you need to convert the text encoding of a configuration file for compatibility with an Android build pipeline. There is a configuration file located at /home/user/build/config_android.txt that was mistakenly saved in ISO-8859-1 encoding. Your task is to: 1. Convert /home/user/build/config_android.txt from ISO-8859-1 to UTF-8 encoding, and write the converted result to /home/user/build/config_android_utf8.txt. 2. Verify the conversion by creating a log file at /home/user/build/encoding_conversion.log with the following format: - The log should be a single line in plain text. - The line must read: config_android.txt converted from ISO-8859-1 to UTF-8 as config_android_utf8.txt 3. Ensure that /home/user/build/config_android_utf8.txt is in UTF-8 encoding and matches the content of the original file, but with proper UTF-8 character representation. 4. After the conversion, print out the contents of /home/user/build/config_android_utf8.txt to the terminal. The automated test will check that the encoding conversion has been correctly performed, that the output file is in UTF-8, and that the log has been written in the exact specified format.
